info.title: Swarmy API
info.description: Version 1 control plane. Additive-only within /v1: new routes and fields may appear, nothing is removed or retyped, and deprecations carry an x-sunset date. See docs/api.md.

latencies.description:
Turn-level latencies (`append_to_first_token`, `inference`,
`append_to_idle`, `placement`) over the rolled-up turns. Per-tool
percentiles are intentionally absent: the rollup scans summary rows
only, and tool timing lives on per-tool detail rows that the rollup
never fans out to.

ApiError.description: `provider_text` preserves the original provider error without rewriting it.

AppendMessage.description: Append a user message at the observed log head.

CliAgentChoice.description: Input for CLI agent creation or settings updates.

record.description: Encrypted by the API, never returned by credential endpoints.

CliRoute.description: CLI projection of a named inference route.

CliRouteDeleted.description: CLI deletion marker for a named route.

CliRouteInput.description: CLI input for replacing a route's steps in order.

CliSession.description: CLI projections retain store record fields for compatibility with existing scripts.

first_tool_bytes_fetched.description: Total bytes re-sampled after the first tool call completes.

first_tool_chunks_fetched.description:
Volume counters re-sampled after the first tool call of the turn
completes. The boot sample above is taken before the first command
runs, so lazy chunk hydration during that command is invisible in it.

first_tool_fetch_p50_ms.description: Fetch p50 re-sampled after the first tool call completes.

first_tool_fetch_p95_ms.description: Fetch p95 re-sampled after the first tool call completes.

CreateAgent.description: Every client mutation has a key that survives retries of the same intent.

CreateCredential.description: Setting the same provider again replaces its credential without exposing its secret on reads.

CreateImage.description: Register an already built image; image builds are not mutations of this resource.

new.description: Open a side conversation rather than the named agent's main session.

Credential.description: Credential metadata contains no secret material.

CredentialDeleted.description: Deleting a labelled credential reports the removal without returning secrets.

Cursor.description: A sequence is local to one log, starts at one, and increases without gaps.

DeleteRequest.description: Body for agent and credential deletions. The key scopes the replayed result.

DoctorSnapshot.description: Protected diagnostic snapshot used by doctor; credential metadata contains no secrets.

EntryQuotaView.description:
Quota view for one entry, either observed or configured. Requests and
tokens are separate observed dimensions; `free` carries requests remaining
and `tokens_remaining` carries tokens remaining. Configured `used` counts
whole hourly buckets overlapping the window (hour granularity).

Event.description: A durable event has a cursor even when delivered on a multiplexed connection.

oneOf.description: Stored events without a dedicated public projection retain their original data.

data.description: Stored events without a dedicated public projection retain their original data.

HealthResponse.description:
The unauthenticated health projection. `api_version` carries the document
version so clients can accept any server with the same major version.

default_provider.description: The provider new conversations use when the request names none.

request_duration_ms.description:
Whole-request duration the store derives from the earliest
`InferenceStarted` stage to the latest `InferenceFinished` stage for
this request id. The window starts when the gateway observes the
attempt (before provider and entry resolution) and ends when the
terminal stage lands, so it includes breaker waits and any backoff
between retries that share the request id. Throughput divides by this
interval, not by the streaming interval, so single-chunk responses do
not report absurd rates.

streamed.description:
Whether the response arrived as more than one content chunk (`Some(true)`
streamed, `Some(false)` delivered whole in one chunk). `None` means the
request produced no content: a failed attempt, or a row written before
the flag existed. Reports skip `None` when counting single-chunk
responses.

LogId.description: A log namespace. The tagged representation reserves channels without changing session cursors.

Route.description: A named inference failover chain over auth entries.

RouteDeleted.description: Deleting a route reports the removal; assigned sessions fall back.

RouteStep.description:
One route step: the provider, the entry label (`*` for every entry of
the provider in creation order), and an optional model override.

SetEntryQuota.description: Operator-configured quota for an entry without published quotas.

SetRoute.description: Setting a route replaces its steps in order.

SetSessionRoute.description: Session route override for one conversation. `None` clears the override.

Subscription.description: One connection may replay and follow several logs at once.

dropped_inference.description:
Remainder of the `inference` array omitted by `inference_limit`, plus
rows dropped by the legacy capped layout when the turn was migrated.

dropped_stages.description:
Always zero for turns written in the unbounded layout; kept so paged
reads have a place for the remainder (unused for stages).

dropped_tools.description:
Remainder of the `tools` array omitted by `tools_limit`, plus rows
dropped by the legacy capped layout when the turn was migrated.

inference.description:
Inference requests in chronological order (earliest start first).
A paged read truncates to `inference_limit` and reports the remainder
in `dropped_inference`.

stages.description:
Anchor and per-request stages reconstructed from the summary and detail
rows: turn anchors (`submitted`, `appended`, `first_token`,
`inference_started`, `inference_finished`, `idle`) plus one
`inference_started` / `first_token` / `inference_finished` triple per
inference request that survives paging. The durable store keeps no
bounded stage list and emits no `first_tool` stage; tool timing lives
on the `tools` rows.

tools.description:
Tool calls in chronological order (earliest dispatch first). A paged
read truncates to `tools_limit` and reports the remainder in
`dropped_tools`.

UpdateSession.description: `close` terminates the session; other fields override inference selection.

WaitingReason.description: An ISO 8601 timestamp is used for `wake_at`; reasons are human-readable.
